description: This PHP source file defines the DataGroupHelper class, which manages permissions and configuration data related to API, Data Groups, and Screens within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for reading YAML configuration files, inserting permission data into the database, and retrieving IDs for modules, data groups, screens, and user roles.

classes.name: DataGroupHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing data groups, API permissions, and screen permissions in the OrangeHRM installer system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DataGroupHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: readApiPermissions
methods.description: Reads API permission configurations from a YAML file and returns an array of Api objects.

methods.name: readDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Reads Data Group permission configurations from a YAML file and returns an array of DataGroup objects.

methods.name: readScreenPermissions
methods.description: Reads Screen permission configurations from a YAML file and returns an array of Screen objects.

methods.name: insertApiPermissions
methods.description: Inserts API permission data into the database from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: insertDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Inserts Data Group permission data into the database from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: insertScreenPermissions
methods.description: Inserts Screen permission data into the database from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: getDataGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a data group by its name.

methods.name: getScreenIdByModuleAndUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a screen by its module ID and URL.

methods.name: getModuleIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a module by its name, with caching.

methods.name: getUserRoleIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a user role by its name, with caching.

methods.name: addDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions for a user role to a data group.
